messages.english: Show crop names and your labels in seed worksheets.
Crop planner → Saved planned nursery batches → Seed sourcing review

Add your own supply-group label and review crop names from the saved nursery batches you selected. The CSV worksheet includes your entered labels. Missing identification stays visible, and crop names do not confirm interchangeable varieties, seed lots or observed stock.
